items.label: Great Value & Chic Style
items.value: This hallway runner rug adds a vibrant touch to your living room with its beautiful colors and subtle pattern that complements your furniture and decor. It's soft to the touch and looks as elegant as more expensive entryway rugs, offering excellent value for its quality.

items.label: Non-Slip Backing
items.value: Our stain-resistant rugs feature a non-slip backing that prevents slipping and skidding. This design helps maintain a consistent look in your home, saves you from frequently reorganizing your spaces, and reduces the risk of trips and falls.

items.label: Soft & Well-Designed
items.value: This low-pile hallway runner features a solid edge design, making it ultra-soft yet durable enough to withstand everyday wear and tear. It's perfect for high-traffic areas such as entryways and under furniture, and its low profile ensures it won't obstruct doorways.

items.label: Machine Washable
items.value: Say goodbye to worries about spills or stains! This runner rug is designed to be stain-resistant and incredibly easy to clean. Simply toss it in the washing machine, use cold water, and hang it to dry or air dry. For everyday maintenance, you can use a robot vacuum, broom, or just wipe it clean. If your vacuum has adjustable power settings, set it to low.

items.label: Tips for Creases
items.value: The kitchen runner rugs may have slight creases from shipping, but there's no need to worry. Simply lay the rug flat in a spacious area and allow it to naturally unfold; the creases will disappear within a week. For more pronounced creases, gently iron the back with a steam iron for quicker recovery.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Foldable, Lightweight, Non Slip, Stain Resistant, Washable

items.label: Room Type
items.value: Bathroom, Bedroom, Hallway, Kitchen, Living Room
